meta.transit_stress: betweenness centrality (unweighted) on the 471-node/587-edge Seoul subway graph (kr_stations + network.geojson), min-max normalized 0-100, quintile tier (very-low..very-high = least..most transit-critical/congested).
meta.walk_stress: HONEST PROXY, coordinates only: station_density_800m = count of OTHER stations within 800m great-circle distance. walk_stress_score = 100 - minmax(density). Fewer nearby stations -> higher walk stress (fewer walkable alternates). NOT based on sidewalks/terrain/pedestrian network.
